description: This file implements a device identification class for a Broadcom device, providing methods to retrieve device information such as architecture, chipset, firmware version, and serial number by reading relevant system files.

classes.name: DeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements device identification interfaces to retrieve hardware and firmware details for a Broadcom device.

methods.name: Architecture
methods.description: Returns the architecture of the device as a string, retrieved via Core::SystemInfo.

methods.name: Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset identifier of the device.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version of the device.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Fills the provided buffer with the device's serial number identifier.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Updates device information fields by reading system files.
